coupleNames.rule: Across P01-P08, never invent, misspell, swap, translate, abbreviate, or OCR-correct Shogo/Shiori without explicit user instruction.

weddingDate.rule: Across P01-P08, 2026.10.24 is authoritative. Never infer another date from generated imagery, examples, OCR, old versions, or placeholders.

visualAuthorityPolicy.principle: Page visual-master images outrank prose-only design interpretation for visual execution.
workflow: lock visual authority in the page manifest
compare production work directly against the visual master
only after visual fidelity passes, perform technical/editability QA
visualAuthorityPolicy.figmaPolicy: Figma is the layered compositor, not the source of magazine personality.
visualAuthorityPolicy.wholePagePolicy: Whole-page reference images are art-direction masters; final editable production remains layered with replaceable photography and native factual copy.
doNot: redesign a page from generic text-only Rurubu rules when a page visual master exists
treat generated factual text as authoritative
let editability requirements weaken the expressive masthead/title art
certify a page on technical QA before 3-second visual-fidelity QA passes

pages.role: REAL LIFE / FAVORITES / BEST SHOTS + Q5/Q6
